description.en: The contractor must provide their name, position, address, telephone, and email.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Submit tender for installation, maintenance, and removal

description.en: Contractors must submit tenders for the provision of Christmas lights installation, maintenance, and removal services.
The tender must be submitted under a 1-year, 2-year, or 3-year service agreement.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Perform installation, maintenance, dismantling, and testing

description.en: The contractor is responsible for the installation, maintenance, dismantling, and testing of the Christmas Lights.
The contractor must comply with all written requirements stated in the tender.
The contractor must have satisfactory references demonstrating ability to deliver similar projects.
The contractor must offer the best value for money based on the evaluation criteria.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Demonstrate ability to deliver similar projects to high quality

description.en: The contractor must demonstrate ability to deliver similar projects to a high quality, weighted at 25%.
The price must fit within the budget, weighted at 25%.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Provide quality and value for money

description.en: The contractor must provide quality and value for money, weighted at 30%.
The contractor must use local resources and skills, weighted at 20%.
Payment for the completed project will be made to the Contractor on satisfactory completion of works.
Any variations to the contract must be notified to the Contractor by the Town Clerk and agreed in writing between the two parties.
The contractor must have made any necessary site visits and satisfied themselves of access arrangements and any other necessary information before submitting a tender.
The tender must be fully inclusive of all costs.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Accept monitoring by Town Council representative

description.en: A Town Council representative will monitor the work carried out on a regular basis, and any concerns will be reported to the Town Clerk who will agree an appropriate course of action with the Contractor.
All tenders will be considered by the Town Council on 9 June 2026.
All tenders will receive a response from the Town Council week commencing 15 June 2026.
All items must be costed individually.
Submission deadline is 2 June 2026.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Arrange site visit with Jenna Munday

description.en: To arrange a site visit, contact Jenna Munday, Town Clerk, at 01952 882172 or townclerk@broseley-tc.gov.uk.
All invitations to tender are subject to the Town Council's Standing Order number 17 and the terms of the Bribery Act 2010.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Do not contact councillors or staff

description.en: No contractor shall contact councillors or staff to encourage or support their tender outside the prescribed process.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Submit tender in sealed marked envelope

description.en: Tenders are to be submitted in writing in a sealed marked envelope addressed to the Town Clerk. The envelope should be clearly marked 'Tender'.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Tenders opened after deadline by Town Clerk with councillors

description.en: Tenders shall be opened by the Town Clerk in the presence of at least two councillors after the deadline for submission of tenders has passed.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Tenders considered at Town Council meeting

description.en: Tenders will be reported to and considered by the Town Council at a properly convened meeting.
Provide a copy of the current public liability certificate.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Provide Highway Electrical Registration Scheme certificate

description.en: Provide a copy of the Highway Electrical Registration Scheme certificate.
Provide a copy of the Health and Safety Policy.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Provide details of proposed LEDs and product warranty

description.en: Provide details of proposed LEDs and product warranty.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Provide any other pertinent documents or certificates

description.en: Provide any other pertinent documents or certificates.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Comply with all relevant H&S legislation

description.en: Contractors must comply with all relevant health and safety legislation.
Measures must be taken to minimize any risk to the public. For example, tools must not be left on the pavement where they could present a trip hazard.
Any motor vehicle or plant machinery used must be parked so as not to contravene any parking restrictions and/or present any obstruction to other road users and the public.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Adhere to relevant codes of practice and regulations

description.en: The Contractor must adhere to the relevant codes of practice and regulations.

The erection, testing and maintenance of the installation must be carried out in accordance with the latest Wiring Regulations (BS 7671) and undertaken by a competent person as laid out in those regulations.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Produce Health & Safety Information prior to installation

description.en: The successful contractor will be expected to produce a Health & Safety Information prior to installation. This will include: Risk Assessment, Method Statement, Schedule of Works, and any other relevant documents such as General Health & Safety at Work Policy, accreditation certificates and staff training certificates.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Work carried out by competent person per BS 7671

description.en: The erection, testing and maintenance of the installation must be carried out in accordance with the latest Wiring Regulations (BS 7671) and undertaken by a competent person as laid out in those regulations.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Include Risk Assessment in H&S Information

description.en: The Health & Safety Information must include a Risk Assessment.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Include Method Statement in H&S Information

description.en: The Health & Safety Information must include a Method Statement.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Include Schedule of Works in H&S Information

description.en: The Health & Safety Information must include a Schedule of Works.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Include other relevant documents in H&S Information

description.en: The Health & Safety Information must include any other relevant documents such as General Health & Safety at Work Policy, accreditation certificates and staff training certificates.
The contractor must have adequate public liability insurance.
A copy of the contractor's current insurance certificate must be included with the tender response.
Installation testing must begin on 1 November 2026.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Complete installation one week before switch-on

description.en: The lights must be in working order no later than one week prior to the notified switch-on date of Saturday 28 November 2026.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Minimize disruption to traffic and environment

description.en: The work must be undertaken in a manner that causes little disruption to traffic both vehicular and pedestrian, as well as with consideration for the environment.
The contractor must be present on the day of the switch-on, Saturday 28 November 2026, to manually switch on the lights after a countdown.
After the switch-on, the lights need to be set to their automatic timers which result in their coming on at 4pm and going off at 10pm weekdays, and 4pm to 11pm weekends.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Respond to concerns with Town Clerk

description.en: Any concerns reported to the Town Clerk will be agreed upon with the Contractor for an appropriate course of action.
The contractor must be present on the day of the switch-on Saturday 28 November 2026 to manually switch on the lights after a countdown.
After the switch-on, the lights need to be set to their automatic timers which result in their coming on at 4pm and going off at 10pm weekdays, and 4pm – 11pm weekends.
The lights must be electrically tested to current standards.
The contractor must check all anchor points for the Christmas lights installation.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Bear cost of replacement anchor points

description.en: The contractor must bear the cost of any replacement anchor points required for the installation.
All electric feeder pillars must be tested.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Install and activate 23 sets of pea lights in memorial garden

description.en: The contractor must install and activate 23 sets of pea lights in the memorial garden.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Install and activate lights on fir tree

description.en: Install and activate 1 set of lights on the fir tree within the memorial garden.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Install and activate pea lights on tree

description.en: Install and activate 1 set of pea lights on the tree located on the square.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Install features to poles in memorial garden

description.en: The contractor must install features to the poles located within the memorial garden.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Install welcome to Broseley sign across high street

description.en: Install the 'welcome to Broseley' sign across the high street, spanning from Victoria Hall to the Bridal Shop.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Install festoons to front of Harwood's building & butchers' shop

description.en: The contractor must install festoon lighting to the front of Harwood's building and the butchers' shop.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Install string lights from church street to social club

description.en: The contractor must install string lights starting from the top of Church Street, zig-zagging up the High Street, and ending at the social club.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Install string lights zig-zagging up high street

description.en: Install string lights from the top of church street zig-zagging up the high street to the social club.
The contractor must install 2 snow fall column mounts.
All lights and features must be fully functioning prior to installation.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Include all-inclusive call-out costs for festival period

description.en: The tender must include the cost of all-inclusive call-outs during the festival period for lights erected and maintenance checks.
The contractor must carry out two scheduled inspections of the display during the display period to verify proper functioning and address minor faults.
The contractor must provide a call-out service within 24 hours for major faults, including complete motif or light string failure, extreme damage from vandalism, storms, or road traffic accidents.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: State additional call-out charges in schedule

description.en: Any additional call-out charges beyond the scheduled maintenance must be clearly stated in the provided schedule.
All anchor points must be tested.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Test all lights and features during downtime

description.en: All lights and features must be tested during downtime, and any minor work such as replacing bulbs and fixing faulty connections must be undertaken.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Notify BTC of defective items requiring major repair

description.en: The contractor must notify BTC immediately of any defective lights and features that require major repair at additional cost or that cannot be repaired, so replacement can be considered in good time.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Remove all lights after the event

description.en: The contractor must remove all Christmas lights and associated installation materials after the event period ends.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Dismantle and remove lights after 6 January

description.en: The lights must be dismantled and removed as soon as possible after 6 January each year, but no later than 12 January each year.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Dismantle and remove lights by 12 January

description.en: The lights must be dismantled and removed no later than 12 January each year.
The contractor must attend the Christmas lights switch-on event.
